step1.ptxt: Steering Angle Neutral Point Deviation Correction

step2.ptxt: If "Initializing System" is displayed on the screen due to disconnecting the battery terminal (battery terminal removal and installation, steering sensor connector removal and installation), etc., perform one of the following operations to correct the steering angle neutral point deviation.

step3.ptxt: Method 1... Turn the steering wheel fully to both the left and right to correct the steering angle neutral point.

Method 2... Drive along a route with as few corners, curves and traffic jams as possible for 20km/h or more, for 5 minutes or more. Then stop the vehicle and check whether the neutral point has been learned. If it has not been learned, repeat the procedure.

atten4.ptxt: The navigation receiver assembly determines the straight-ahead condition and the neutral point is learned

step2.ptxt: Display deviation due to causes other than steering angle neutral point deviation

step3.ptxt: If the steering wheel installation angle is misaligned, the vehicle width extension lines and expected course lines are misaligned when the steering wheel is in the straight-ahead position.
If camera optical axis adjustment has not been performed correctly, the vehicle width extension lines and expected course lines are misaligned.

atten4.ptxt: Inspect the connection condition of each ECU and the DTC output.
Install the adjustment target only when performing camera optical axis adjustment.

step3.ptxt: Stop the vehicle with the steering wheel in the straight-ahead position.
Place the adjustment target bars in the positions shown in the illustration.

item.ptxt: The adjustment target bar is made by applying tape approximately 2.5cm wide and 2m long to the floor; check the color on the vehicle display and choose a conspicuous color.
Before stopping the vehicle, move the vehicle slightly forward and backward, and check that not only the steering wheel but also the tires are in the straight-ahead position.

step3.ptxt: Turn the engine ON (engine running).
Start the diagnosis. (see )
Select "Camera Inspection" on the diagnosis inspection menu screen.
Check the condition of the vehicle speed signal (part A) input to the navigation receiver assembly.
If part A shows "Vehicle Speed Input OK" (displayed in blue), it is normal, so proceed to steering angle adjustment.

atten4.ptxt: The vehicle speed signal is displayed in blue if it has been input even once in the past.

step3.ptxt: If "Checking Vehicle Speed Input" (displayed in red) is shown, perform inspection according to the instructions in List by Symptom [Vehicle Speed Signal Inspection Result Abnormal]. (see )

item.ptxt: If the signal has not been input, "Checking Vehicle Speed Input" is displayed and the icon is shown in red.
If "Checking Vehicle Speed Input" is red, it is not possible to proceed to the next screen.

If "Checking Vehicle Speed Input" (displayed in red) is shown, it is not possible to proceed to the next screen unless "Checking Vehicle Speed Input" is touched (changes from red to orange) and then "Next" is touched.

step3.ptxt: Check that the vehicle steering wheel is in the straight-ahead position (approximately straight, ±5 degrees or less as a guide), and press "Steering Angle Neutral Point Memory".

item.ptxt: When removing, installing or replacing the television camera assembly, steering angle adjustment is not necessary, so select "Next" on the steering angle adjustment screen.
Even when only memorizing the steering angle neutral point, the value is not stored unless the diagnosis inspection screen is ended with "Next"... "Complete".

step3.ptxt: After memorizing the steering angle neutral point, turn the steering wheel to the left until it stops, then to the right until it stops, and press "Maximum Steering Angle Memory". The LH/RH maximum steering angles are stored at the moment the button is pressed. (Right may be done first)

item.ptxt: If all input signals are being input normally, the screen automatically switches to the camera optical axis adjustment screen after the maximum steering angle is memorized.
Touching "Next" is not accepted until the steering angle neutral point and maximum steering angle have been memorized.

step3.ptxt: Press switch A or B to rotate C so that it is parallel to the adjustment target bar.
Press switches D, E, F and G to move C left, right, up and down so that the adjustment target bar is in the center of the middle of C (red frame).
Select "Next".

Check that A (indicating 1170mm beyond the bumper edge) and the adjustment target bar almost overlap. Also, check that the expected course lines are straight (overlapping the vehicle width extension lines) when the steering is in the straight-ahead position.
Select "Complete" to return to the diagnosis inspection menu.
To cancel, turn the IG OFF. Or press the "Picture/Off" key for 3 seconds or more.

When maximum steering angle memorization has been performed, check on the screen after ending the diagnosis inspection that the expected course lines move in conjunction with the steering wheel until it is turned fully to the left and right.

atten4.ptxt: If the expected course lines stop moving before the steering wheel is turned fully to the left and right, the maximum steering angle has not been stored correctly and readjustment is necessary.
